title: Niagara Falls Day Tour from Toronto w/ Tower, Journey & Boat Ride
includes: Public transportation (bus, subway, cable car, etc.)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Embark on the Epic Niagara Falls Tour, the ultimate Niagara Falls adventure from Toronto! This exclusive 8-hour small-group driving tour begins with convenient pickup from anywhere in downtown Toronto. Get up close to the mighty Falls on a guided experience featuring iconic attractions like Journey Behind the Falls, a breathtaking ride with Niagara City Cruises, panoramic views from the Skylon Tower, and visits to scenic landmarks such as the Floral Clock and Niagara Whirlpool.

After your tour, enjoy one hour of free time to grab a bite, explore, or soak in the views before heading back to Toronto. Led by a friendly local guide, this all-in-one experience offers the best of Niagara with comfort and style.
